sentences.zh: 我一眼就认出她演过电视剧《火线警探》。
她扮演的是雷切尔·布鲁克斯。

sentences.en: Erika is a classically trained actress.
sentences.zh: 埃里卡是一位受过正统训练的演员。

sentences.en: She graduated with an MFA from the NYU acting program.
sentences.zh: 她毕业于纽约大学表演专业，获得艺术硕士学位。

sentences.en: Her professional acting debut was at the New York Shakespeare Festival.
sentences.zh: 她的职业表演首秀是在纽约莎士比亚节上。

sentences.en: And since we've been tracking these things, I'll have you know she was not on Monk,
sentences.zh: 既然我们一直在追踪这些事，我得告诉你她没有演过《神探阿蒙》，

sentences.en: but she has been on both Law & Order and Law & Order Special Victims Unit.
sentences.zh: 但她演过《法律与秩序》和《法律与秩序：特殊受害者》。

sentences.en: I loved all of her reactions to Andy.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢她对安迪的所有反应了。

sentences.en: And this whole thing has just completely ticked off Stanley.
sentences.zh: 而且整件事彻底把斯坦利惹恼了。

sentences.en: He's like, what are you doing?
And Andy says he loves Julia with all his heart.
sentences.zh: 然后安迪说他全心全意地爱着朱莉娅。

sentences.en: Stanley is like, if you really love her, fine.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利的意思是，如果你真的爱她，行吧。

sentences.en: Give me two of your clients.
sentences.zh: 把你的两个客户让给我。

sentences.en: So Andy takes over the meeting in a very awkward way.
sentences.zh: 于是安迪以一种非常尴尬的方式接管了会议。

sentences.en: He wonders, where should we send your invoices?
sentences.zh: 他纳闷，我们该把发票寄到哪里？
因为我们当然可以这样做。

sentences.en: He's like, no, you can send it to my work address.
sentences.zh: 他就像是，不用，你可以寄到我的工作地址。

sentences.en: But Andy does find out she does not have a boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 但安迪确实发现她并没有男朋友。

sentences.en: And then he kind of panics.
And then he gets advice from Creed.
sentences.zh: 接着他从克里德那里得到了建议。

sentences.en: Why would you go to Creed for advice?
sentences.zh: 你为什么会去找克里德要建议？

sentences.en: Just go in for a kiss.
That's how I got squeaky from.
sentences.zh: 我当年就是这么把斯奎奇弄到手的。

sentences.en: I didn't know who that was.
Oh, you didn't know who it was?
She was part of the Manson family.
She tried to assassinate Gerald Ford.
sentences.zh: 她试图行刺杰拉尔德·福特。

sentences.en: She was not part of the Tate-LaBianca murders, but she did try to assassinate Gerald Ford.
sentences.zh: 她没有参与莎朗·塔特和拉比安卡谋杀案，但她确实试图行刺杰拉尔德·福特。

sentences.en: So I guess Creed kissed her.
sentences.zh: 所以我想克里德吻了她。

sentences.en: And he says, have I ever steered you wrong, Jim?
sentences.zh: 然后他说，吉姆，我什么时候坑过你？

sentences.en: Just go in and kiss her.
That just, you know, that's what you should do.
sentences.zh: 这简直，你知道的，这就是你应该做的。

sentences.en: When he called Andy Jim, if you're Andy, wouldn't you think, hmm, there's many reasons
sentences.zh: 当他管安迪叫吉姆时，如果你是安迪，难道你不会想，嗯，有很多原因

sentences.en: Well, for whatever reason, Andy is going to take Creed's advice.
sentences.zh: 好吧，不管出于什么原因，安迪打算听从克里德的建议。

sentences.en: He's going to walk Julia to the car.
sentences.zh: 他要送朱莉娅去车那儿。

sentences.en: Could he run back in and get it real quick?
sentences.zh: 他能跑回去飞快地拿一下吗？

sentences.en: Julia says, my car's right here, I think.
sentences.zh: 朱莉娅说，我的车就在这儿，我想是的。

sentences.en: Thanks for walking me down, but I'm good.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你送我下来，不过我自己行。

sentences.en: And then when he gets her to the car, he goes in for a kiss.
sentences.zh: 然后当他把她送到车旁时，他凑过去想亲吻她。

sentences.en: This woman has had to put up with so much in this meeting.
sentences.zh: 这个女人在这个会议上已经忍受了太多。

sentences.en: Also, like, she could write him up.
sentences.zh: 而且，她完全可以写报告告发他。

sentences.en: He could lose his job, Andy.
sentences.zh: 他可能会丢了工作，安迪。
他们确实丢了这个客户。

sentences.en: So he kind of lost in every way today.
sentences.zh: 所以他今天可以说是全盘皆输。

sentences.en: He lost two that he gave to Stanley.
sentences.zh: 他丢了两个转给斯坦利的客户。

sentences.en: One that Stanley gave to him.
And he kind of showed his ass.
Well, speaking of showing your ass, Karen has asked Michael to leave the conference room
sentences.zh: 说到出丑，凯伦要求迈克尔离开会议室

sentences.en: It's like getting called to the principal's office.
sentences.zh: 就像被叫去校长办公室一样。

sentences.en: And he is trying very hard to explain that he had a whole bit with a chainsaw that he
sentences.zh: 他正极力解释说，他本来设计了一段关于电锯的表演

sentences.en: And Karen's like, you know what?
Why don't you just put it all in an email and I'll send it to my team?
sentences.zh: 你干脆把这些都写进邮件里，我发给我的团队吧？

sentences.en: And he's like, I can't put a chainsaw in an email, Karen.
sentences.zh: 而他说，我没法把电锯塞进邮件里，凯伦。

sentences.en: This is when Pam and Karen are going to have a little bonding moment.
sentences.zh: 接下来是帕姆和凯伦增进感情的时刻。

sentences.en: Pam says, when are you due?
sentences.zh: 帕姆问，你预产期是什么时候？

sentences.en: And Karen says, I'm due in a month.
sentences.zh: 凯伦说，我的预产期在一个月后。

sentences.en: Michael says, who did this to you?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说，是谁对你做出这种事？

sentences.en: Who did this to you, Karen?
sentences.zh: 是谁对你做出这种事，凯伦？

sentences.en: And then they have all these cute photos.
sentences.zh: 然后他们有好多这种可爱的照片。

sentences.en: They have one where they're like dressed like hot dogs.
sentences.zh: 有一张是他们打扮成热狗的模样。

sentences.en: A hot dog and a hamburger.
We had a lot of fan questions about this.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多粉丝关于这部分的提问。

sentences.en: Everyone wants to know who is the man in the photo?
sentences.zh: 大家都想知道照片里的男人是谁？

sentences.en: Who is Dan, the dermatologist who is married to Karen?
sentences.zh: 那个娶了凯伦的皮肤科医生丹是谁？

sentences.en: Well, it was played by writer Dan Gore.
sentences.zh: 其实是由编剧丹·戈尔扮演的。

sentences.en: He was a writer on Parks and Recreation.
sentences.zh: 他是《公园与游憩》的编剧。

sentences.en: Yes, and he had been working with Mike Schur and Greg Daniels as they developed that show.
sentences.zh: 是的，当麦克·舒尔和格雷格·丹尼尔斯开发那部剧时，他一直在和他们合作。

sentences.en: And we had seen him a few times on set and in the writer's room meeting with those guys.
sentences.zh: 我们在片场和编剧室里见过他好几次，他当时正和那些人开会。

sentences.en: And he came to set one day when we were shooting on the stages.
sentences.zh: 有一天我们在摄影棚拍戏时，他来到了片场。

sentences.en: And he and Rashida dressed up in all these different outfits.
sentences.zh: 他和拉什达换上了各种不同的服装。

sentences.en: And they went around and took pictures.
Well, you know, now Karen is going to ask about Jim.
sentences.zh: 好了，你知道的，现在凯伦要问起吉姆了。

sentences.en: It's a little bit of tension, but Pam says we're engaged.
sentences.zh: 气氛有点紧张，但帕姆说我们订婚了。

sentences.en: And Karen is just earnestly happy for them.
sentences.zh: 凯伦是真心替他们感到高兴。

sentences.en: Because I think as an audience, you're like, oh, what's that?
sentences.zh: 因为我想作为观众，你会想，哦，那是什么情况？

sentences.en: And she's like, she has so moved on.
sentences.zh: 而她表现得好像已经完全放下了。

sentences.en: I don't know about you, Ange, but I am happy if someone I have broken up with finds, like, a new relationship with someone else and they're in love.
sentences.zh: 安吉，我不知道你怎么想，但如果我和前任分手后，对方找到了新恋情并且坠入爱河，我是会替他们高兴的。

sentences.en: Because I'm like, yeah, that's why we broke up.
sentences.zh: 因为我会觉得，对啊，这就是我们当初分手的原因。

sentences.en: And then you found your match.
sentences.zh: 然后你找到了你的真命天子。

sentences.en: I don't have a lot of hard feelings about stuff.
sentences.zh: 我对很多事情其实都没什么怨恨。

sentences.en: And I've had some messy breakups, you know?
sentences.zh: 而且我也经历过一些乱七八糟的分手，你知道吧？

sentences.en: And even still, I don't know.
I just, I think I am more Karen on this one.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我觉得在这件事上我更像凯伦。
我很高兴事情能圆满解决。

sentences.en: It wasn't meant to be for me and Jim.
sentences.zh: 我和吉姆注定是有缘无分。

sentences.en: But it's for you and Jim.
sentences.zh: 但你和吉姆就是天作之合。

sentences.en: No, I think life is short.
My grandmother used to always say, every pot has its lid.
sentences.zh: 我外婆以前常说，锅配锅，盖配盖。

sentences.en: And I want everyone to find their lid.
sentences.zh: 我希望每个人都能找到自己的另一半。

sentences.en: I was too big for your pot.
sentences.zh: 我对你的锅来说太大了。

sentences.en: Or too small for your pot.
sentences.zh: 或者对你的锅来说太小了。

sentences.en: Let's break it down some more.
sentences.zh: 我们再来仔细剖析一下。

sentences.en: I'm trying to see if there's a that's what she said in there.
sentences.zh: 我在看看这里面有没有一句“她刚才说”。

sentences.en: My lid fit your pot perfect?
sentences.zh: 我的盖子跟你的锅完美契合？

sentences.en: I think it would be, your pot fit my lid just right.
sentences.zh: 我觉得应该是，你的锅跟我的盖子刚刚好。

sentences.en: I don't think either of them are real strong.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这两句都不怎么带劲。

sentences.en: If you find it, will you email us?
sentences.zh: 要是你们找到了，能给我们发邮件吗？
有一些有趣的邮件要读。

sentences.en: I don't know where we are.
Michael and Pam are going to leave the Utica branch.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔和帕姆要离开尤蒂卡分公司了。

sentences.en: Michael gives his lecture a B+.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔给自己的演讲打了B+。

sentences.en: And then Pam says she's glad she came along and that seeing Karen gave her closure.
sentences.zh: 然后帕姆说很高兴她一起去了，而且见到凯伦让她了结了心愿。

sentences.en: Well, that's going to come back because as they're driving away, Michael tells Pam,
sentences.zh: 好吧，这事儿还没完，因为当他们开车离开时，迈克尔对帕姆说，

sentences.en: I never got closure with Holly.
sentences.zh: 我和霍莉从来没有真正了结过。

sentences.en: She was the love of my life and I never got closure.
sentences.zh: 她是我一生所爱，而我们从来没有真正了结。

sentences.en: So, Pam says, I think we should blow off this lecture in Rochester and go to Nashua instead.
sentences.zh: 所以，帕姆说，我觉得我们别去罗切斯特那个讲座了，改去纳舒厄吧。

sentences.en: Pam is like, yeah, screw them.
sentences.zh: 帕姆就像是，对，管他们的。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, Michael just got, what do the kids call it, a ride or die.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，迈克尔就，现在小屁孩儿怎么说来着，生死相随了。

sentences.en: And then we have to be continued.
Jim is asking Creed for $3 for Kelly's party.
sentences.zh: 吉姆向克里德要3美元办凯莉的派对。

sentences.en: And then he hands him a $3 bill.
sentences.zh: 然后他递给吉姆一张3美元的钞票。

sentences.en: I had to know whose face was on that $3 bill.
sentences.zh: 我必须知道那张3美元钞票上印的是谁的脸。

sentences.en: Because, you know, Phil Shea had to make that.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，道具师菲尔·希a得做那个。

sentences.en: You know who I thought it was?
sentences.zh: 你知道我以为那是谁吗？

sentences.en: It looked like Brad Pitt to me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那就是布拉德·皮特。

sentences.en: And I thought maybe it was a nod to BJ because he was doing the movie with Brad Pitt.
sentences.zh: 而且我以为这可能是在向BJ致敬，因为他当时正和布拉德·皮特合作拍电影。

sentences.en: I remember we talked a lot about Brad Pitt when BJ was making that movie.
sentences.zh: 我记得在BJ拍那部电影的时候，我们经常讨论布拉德·皮特。

sentences.en: We all thought we might become friends with him.
sentences.zh: 我们都以为我们可能会和他成为朋友。

sentences.en: We were like, BJ, bring him to set.
sentences.zh: 我们当时就说，BJ，把他带到片场来吧。

sentences.en: Maybe he'd like to come have lunch.
sentences.zh: 也许他会愿意来吃午饭。
记得我们经历过的那次吗。

sentences.en: He never brought him to work.
sentences.zh: 他从来没把他带到片场过。

sentences.en: We went through that with John and George Clooney, too.
sentences.zh: 我们对约翰和乔治·克鲁尼也经历过那种事。

sentences.en: We were like, John, we're going to be so normal around George.
sentences.zh: 我们当时说，约翰，我们在乔治面前一定会表现得非常正常。

sentences.en: We're not going to bring up, you know, his place in Lake Como and that we want to go.
sentences.zh: 我们不会提起，你知道的，他在科莫湖的宅邸，以及我们想去那里。

sentences.en: We won't say that we read about it in People Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我们不会说我们在《人物》杂志上读到过关于它的事。

sentences.en: We won't say any of those things.
sentences.zh: 我们不会说任何这些事情。

sentences.en: Well, it turns out Randy Cordray told me who's on the $3 bill.
sentences.zh: 好吧，结果兰迪·科德雷告诉我三美元纸币上印的是谁。

sentences.en: He said Phil made it, and that's who he put on it.
sentences.zh: 他说那是菲尔制作的，那就是他印在上面的人。
我想我确实是这么觉得的。

sentences.en: You guys, that's Lecture Circuit Part 1.
sentences.zh: 各位，那是《讲座巡回赛（上）》。

sentences.en: We'll be back next week with Lecture Circuit Part 2 and a lot of stories about licking cats.
sentences.zh: 我们下周将带着《讲座巡回赛（下）》以及许多关于舔猫的趣事回归。
你刚才那句话太有中西部味儿了。

sentences.en: And a lot of stories about licking cats.
sentences.zh: 以及许多关于舔猫的趣事。

sentences.en: Sometimes your Missouri really comes out, and I live for it.
sentences.zh: 有时候你的密苏里味儿真的藏不住，我太爱了。

sentences.en: Here, I'll give you some Missouri.
sentences.zh: 来，我给你来点密苏里味儿。

sentences.zh: 感谢收听《办公室女士：第二杯》。
